bugs.description: The result channel can hold only one value even though Run waits for every sender before it starts receiving.
bugs.reachablePreconditions: Run receives at least two jobs, so a worker blocks after the single buffer slot is occupied.
bugs.observableImpact: workers.Wait never completes and the entire batch hangs instead of returning results.
bugs.provenance: Seeded channel-capacity regression with an unchanged timeout-based test that passes on the base revision and deterministically fails at head.
